notes.title: Bubble Boy 1.1 The Arin Update
notes.content:
Dear Bubble Boy players!

After the recent Bubble Boy video by GameGrumps, it has come to my attention that the game had some flaws. It is said that Arin from GameGrumps is still mentally recovering from the game after fully losing his sanity, and we wish him well. 

I had originally planned to let the player figure out the controls on their own, adding to the difficulty, but this turns out not to be as easy as I had anticipated. Resulting in people getting too frustrated, not knowing how the game works, getting confused about what they did or perhaps didn't do wrong. Based on feedback from the video, the comments, as well as feedback from various places on Steam, I have made this update.


Here is what was added or changed:

[list]
[*] Improved tutorial and explanation of the game's mechanics.
[*] The camera is now more zoomed out.
[*] Tips while playing the game.
[*] More effects when the bubble gets too small and is about to pop.
[*] More effects when the bubble gets too close to something. 
[/list]


Please let me know how you like these changes, and if there's anything else you'd like to see added to or changed in the game!

Tim
